uncertainties.note: Referent of the pronoun ("that guy") is ambiguous between Holland (named one row earlier at dialogue_03568 as the Gekko is abandoned) and Berkt (the mission's named pursuit target, asked about at dialogue_03553). Translated with a neutral 'him' that reads correctly under either identity; no specific identity was asserted.

Speaker order around reaching the target point and Berkt's appearance is untagged. dialogue_03609's self-congratulatory remark could be a teammate reacting to their own arrival, or a sardonic aside as Berkt watches them approach. dialogue_03611's cold dismissal is read as Berkt, based on the named callout at dialogue_03610 and his glossary-sourced 'reserved, hostile' personality, not an explicit speaker tag.

'The previous great war' (mae no taisen) is Gundam Wing's own backstory conflict, referenced while Heero explains sealing away Zero; this is a different war from the project's locked 'First Defensive War' term (which belongs to the ACE3-continuity storyline), so the unrelated locked term was not substituted here.

Row's box is left open in the source (no closing command), and the reply lands in the next slice's first row (dialogue_03629). Flagged only because the exchange crosses the 80-row slice boundary, not because of any translation doubt in this row.
